verified_facts.text: The hotel sits next to Eduardo VII Park, just above the Avenida da Liberdade.
verified_facts.excerpt: Next to the peaceful Eduardo VII Park, just above the Avenida da Liberdade and with views over the old city and the Tagus River

verified_facts.text: The hotel has views over the old city and the Tagus River.
verified_facts.excerpt: just above the Avenida da Liberdade and with views over the old city and the Tagus River, the InterContinental Lisbon offers a unique setting

verified_facts.text: The hotel is located in Lisbon's City Centre and is centrally located to visit the capital's museums, monuments and castles.
verified_facts.excerpt: the InterContinental Lisbon is centrally located to visit the capital city's museums, monuments, castles, and other cultural destinations.

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites have natural light and modern decor with soft neutral tones, and overlook Eduardo VII Park, the historic old town and the Tagus River.
verified_facts.excerpt: Boasting natural light and modern décor with soft neutral tones, our tranquil rooms and suites overlook Eduardo VII Park, Lisbon’s historic old town, and Tagus River.

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites with balconies are on the hotel's upper floors and have a private terrace with a view over the city and the river.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our rooms and suites with balconies are distinguished by their exclusive location on the hotel's upper floors. Featuring a private terrace, these rooms boast an incredible view over the city and the river

verified_facts.text: The One Bedroom Suite with Terrace is on the 15th floor and has a terrace overlooking the city of Lisbon.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our exclusive One Bedroom Suite with Terrace features a terrace with a view overlooking the city of Lisbon. Located on the 15th floor

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers Two Storey Suites, including a Two Storey Suite with Terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: ### Two Storey Suite with Terrace

verified_facts.text: Akla, the signature restaurant, serves contemporary Portuguese dishes and has Portuguese tiled panels in its decor.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located next to the hotel lobby, Akla features a modern design and elegant decor with Portuguese tiled panels.

verified_facts.text: At Akla, Chef Eddy Melo works with Portuguese seasonal ingredients.
verified_facts.excerpt: The restaurant offers Portuguese seasonal ingredients that combined with Chef Eddy Melo's international working experience

verified_facts.text: The Uptown Bar has mirrored walls and mood lighting and serves cocktails made with local artisanal products and Portuguese wines.
verified_facts.excerpt: In a striking, modern space with mirrored walls and mood lighting, the Uptown Bar serves a menu of innovative drinks mixed with local artisanal products.

verified_facts.text: The InterContinental Club Lounge offers a tranquil space with views of Lisbon.
verified_facts.excerpt: The InterContinental Club Lounge offers an elegant and tranquil space designed for comfort, productivity, and relaxation. Enjoy refined surroundings with views of Lisbon

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers a valet parking service.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our hotel features an exclusive Valet Parking service, so you don't need to worry about parking the car and unloading your bags somewhere else.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is pet friendly.
verified_facts.excerpt: We welcome pets at InterContinental Lisbon, making it easy for you to enjoy the city with your four-legged companion by your side.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's Incredible Occasions program helps guests celebrate milestone birthdays, proposals or dinner parties.
verified_facts.excerpt: Whether you’re planning a milestone birthday, a romantic proposal, or a stylish dinner party (pajamas optional!), we’ll help you create memories that last a lifetime.

verified_facts.text: The Coimbra Ballroom can be divided into two.
verified_facts.excerpt: Being divisible into 2, the room offers multiple settings and a wide range of possibilities
